label: Bible Study
prompt: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the _____, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verse: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
note: Jesus read this passage aloud in the Nazareth synagogue, then said it was fulfilled that day.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall _____ him as he is.
verse: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
note: We don't know everything about what we'll be — but we know we'll see Him as He is.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Make thee an ark of _____ wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verse: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
note: Gopher wood appears exactly once in the Bible, and nobody is quite sure what tree it was.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's _____: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verse: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
note: Isaiah's opening rebuke: even an ox knows where to find its master's feeding trough; Israel doesn't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and _____ my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
verse: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
note: Keep my sabbaths, 'reverence' my sanctuary — holy time and holy space, repeated word for word in Leviticus 26:2.
